title: Puzzle 3d Reference Inspector Details
description: Show all reference transform information (position, rotation, tilt, scale in all directions, etc.) in the puzzle 3d details/inspector panel when a reference is selected.
summary: Added reference inspector section to buildPuzzle3dPlayInspectorBody showing position, tilt (euler degrees), quaternion, per-axis scale, uniform scale factor, width, opacity, source metadata, and hidden/locked state. Added patchPuzzle3dReference command for editing transform fields from the details panel. Updated inspector header and selection label for references. Play tests 73/73 pass.
